# V4.0 golden fixtures (SYNTHETIC SOFTWARE TEST data)

These files are **synthetic software test fixtures**. No DNA was synthesised, stored or sequenced. Strands are the
output of the released VNX-DNA V4 encoder; reads are produced by the SIMULATED channel (`vnxdna/v4/channel.py`) at fixed
seeds with mild substitution/insertion/deletion rates and coverage 6 (a stress setting, not a fitted sequencing model).

- Generated by: released tree V4, commit d235239 (read-only; the tree was not modified).
- Regenerate: `PYTHONPATH=<tree>/src python generate.py <tree>`. Output is deterministic; `SHA256SUMS` must not change.
- Cases: `balanced` (profile v4-balanced), `archival` (v4-archival), `encrypted` (v4-balanced, AES-256-GCM, test passphrase
  recorded in `manifest.json`, fixed test-only archive id and salt), `multifile` (3 files plus a sub-directory).
- Per case: `<case>.vnx` container, `<case>.strands.fasta` clean strands, `<case>.reads.fastq.gz` noisy simulated reads
  (gzip, mtime 0; decompress before decoding). `manifest.json` lists payload SHA-256s, container SHA-256, seeds.
- The passphrase protects nothing real; it is a public test value.
- Used by `tests/compat/test_v4_v5_archives.py`. Never regenerate these with a newer tree.
